name: Aphrodite
subtitle: Heavenly Desire
description: Charms and Dazes her foes with spells of her beauty while empowering her allies to fight for her.
lore: The Olympian goddess of love and beauty, Aphrodite is often mistaken for a gentle or even meek goddess. In truth, her wrath when she is spurned or slighted—sometimes to only the faintest degree—is dreadful. This tendency has only increased since the Shattering, as her obsessions with certain gods or heroes of other domains is not always returned in kind.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when placing a [Buff] on an ally.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Lovers Duet
skills.description:
Attack 1 enemy. Allies under [mechanic:spd-up-ii] and [INT Up II] will join this attack, using their default ability.
After attacking, place [mechanic:spd-up-ii] for 1 turn on this hero.

skills.name: Divine Sacrament
skills.description: Target 1 Ally and place [mechanic:spd-up-ii] and [mechanic:init-up-ii] for 1 turn, then gain an [Extra Turn].

skills.name: Eternal Bonds
skills.description:
Attack all enemies then extends the duration of any [mechanic:spd-up-ii] and [mechanic:init-up-ii] on all allies by 1 turn.
Also increases the Turn Meter and Divinity of all allies by 15%. This effect is doubled on allies who are under [mechanic:spd-up-ii] and [mechanic:init-up-ii].
skills.awakening_bonus: Remove all [Disable] and [Debuff] from allies under [SPD Up II] and [INIT Up II].

skills.name: Motivation
skills.description: Allies gain 2% Turn Meter when inflicting damage to an enemy. This effect is doubled on allies who are under [mechanic:spd-up-ii] and [mechanic:init-up-ii].
skills.awakening_bonus: Allies under [SPD Up II] and [Init Up II] gain 20% increased incoming healing and inflict 20% increased damage.

imprint_passive: Allies gain 1% Turn Meter when inflicting damage to an enemy. This effect is doubled on allies who are under [SPD Up II] and [INIT Up II].
